overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（8 篇）、绿色金融与可持续发展（2 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（1 篇）。方法上以回归分析、均衡模型为主。来源分布：arXiv（7 篇）、Semantic Scholar（5 篇）。

papers.title: Estimation of distribution functions, their jumps and interval probabilities under measurement error
papers.abstract: We consider the classical additive measurement-error model $X=Y+Z$, where the latent random variable $Y$ has unknown distribution $F_Y$ and the error $Z$ has a known distribution. We develop direct estimators for three functionals of $F_Y$: (i) $F_Y(x)$ at continuity points; (ii) interval probabilities $F_Y(y)-F_Y(x)$ when $x<y$ are continuity points; and (iii) the size of a jump at a prespecified discontinuity. We derive non-asymptotic bias and variance bounds, and establish asymptotic unbiasedness and consistency. Unlike previous work, we do not require $F_Y$ to admit a density, have a mixture representation, or satisfy global Sobolev smoothness assumptions. The framework accommodates arbitrary latent distributions, including those with both discrete and continuous components, and distributions with multiple jumps. These results rely on a link between Fourier inversion theorems and the algebraic structure of a class of estimators proposed in Mynbaev, Martins-Filho and Henderson (2022). A simulation study evaluates feasible tuning procedures and, where available, compares the finite-sample performance of the proposed estimators with existing methods.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了经典的加性测量误差模型 $X=Y+Z$，其中潜在随机变量 $Y$ 的分布 $F_Y$ 是未知的，而误差 $Z$ 的分布是已知的。我们为 $F_Y$ 的三个函数值开发了直接估计量：(i) 在连续点处的 $F_Y(x)$；(ii) 当 $x<y$ 且 $x, y$ 均为连续点时，区间概率 $F_Y(y)-F_Y(x)$；(iii) 在预先指定的不连续点处的跳跃幅度。我们推导了非渐近偏差和方差界限，并证明了渐近无偏性和一致性。与以往的研究不同，我们的方法不要求 $F_Y$ 具有密度函数、混合分布形式或满足全局 Sobolev 光滑性假设。该框架适用于各种潜在分布，包括同时包含离散部分和连续部分的分布，以及具有多个跳跃的分布。这些结果基于 Fourier 逆定理与 Mynbaev、Martins-Filho 和 Henderson（2022）提出的估计量类代数结构之间的联系。通过模拟研究评估了可行的参数调整方法，并在条件允许的情况下，将所提出的估计量的有限样本性能与现有方法进行了比较。。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: FlowLOB: Efficient and Controllable Limit Order Book Generation with Flow Matching
papers.abstract: Limit order book (LOB) simulators are most useful to practitioners when they combine realistic market dynamics, computationally efficient sampling, controllable scenario generation, and the ability to generalize beyond the instruments seen during training---properties that existing agent-based and deep generative simulators provide only partially. We present \textbf{FlowLOB}, a conditional \textbf{flow}-matching generator of \textbf{LOB} trajectories, trained on multiple Hong Kong Exchange (HKEX) symbols at three sampling frequencies ($0.1$s, $1$s, $10$s) in tick-relative representation that transfers to unseen instruments. Because flow and diffusion models admit a common formulation, we train both with identical data, architecture, and budget, and sample both through the same fixed-step ODE solvers, yielding a controlled comparison of sampling efficiency and fidelity. Flow matching attains its best quality with only $10$ ODE-solver steps, whereas diffusion needs many more function evaluations to approach the same fidelity. At this efficient operating point, FlowLOB improves realism over baselines, two learned and two agent-based models, in most distributional metrics at the two finer sampling frequencies. We evaluate counterfactual controllability with a distributional test that asks whether changing a scenario condition moves the generated statistic toward the corresponding real tail regime; FlowLOB satisfies this criterion in most tested settings. Both realism and control effects transfer zero-shot on a held-out symbol. We additionally conduct ablation studies on the network architecture and the learning rate.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】限价单簿（LOB）模拟器对于实践者来说最为有用，因为它们结合了真实的市场动态、计算效率高的采样方法、可控的情景生成能力，以及能够泛化到训练期间未涉及的交易品种的能力——而这些特性是现有的基于代理的模拟器和深度生成模拟器仅部分具备的。我们提出了FlowLOB，这是一种基于条件流的LOB轨迹生成器，它在三种采样频率（0.1秒、1秒、10秒）下针对香港交易所（HKEX）的多个交易品种进行了训练，采用tick相对表示法，并能够应用于未见过的新交易品种。由于流模型和扩散模型具有共同的数学表述方式，我们使用相同的数据、架构和预算对两者进行训练，并通过相同的固定步长常微分方程（ODE）求解器进行采样，从而能够对比两者的采样效率和逼真度。FlowLOB仅需10次ODE求解器迭代就能达到最佳效果，而扩散模型则需要更多的函数评估才能达到类似的逼真度。在这个高效的操作点上，FlowLOB在两种更精细的采样频率下，大多数分布指标上都优于基线模型（包括两种学习得到的模型和两种基于代理的模型）。我们通过一种分布测试来评估反事实可控性，即判断改变情景条件是否会使生成的统计数据向相应的真实尾部区域移动；Flow...。

papers.title: FROM ETHICAL CONSIDERATION TO FINANCIAL DETERMINANT: A SYSTEMATIC LITERATURE REVIEW OF ESG IN SUSTAINABLE FINANCE
papers.venue: The International Conference on Sustainable Economics Management and Accounting Proceeding
papers.abstract: This study systematically reviews the literature on ESG in sustainable finance to examine how ESG has been conceptualized, measured, and evaluated in financial management research, and to identify theoretical, methodological, and empirical gaps for future inquiry. A systematic literature review was conducted following the PRISMA 2020 guideline. The search was performed in Scopus for the period 2016–2026 using predefined ESG and sustainable finance keywords. From 1,591 records identified, screening and eligibility assessment resulted in 28 final studies. Methodological quality was assessed using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool (MMAT), and the evidence was synthesized through thematic and narrative synthesis supported by framework-based logic. The review shows that ESG is conceptualized as a disclosure mechanism, risk signal, governance device, investment criterion, and value-creation driver. Empirical findings suggest that ESG contributes to financing efficiency, cost of capital reduction, equity financing, banking stability, portfolio resilience, and green innovation; however, these effects remain context-dependent and vary by ESG measurement, country, industry, method, and time horizon. ESG has become a central construct in sustainable finance, yet the evidence remains fragmented. This review contributes by integrating dispersed findings and proposing future research on causal mechanisms, disaggregated ESG dimensions, and underexplored financial contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】本研究系统地回顾了可持续金融领域中关于环境、社会和治理（ESG）的文献，探讨了ESG在财务管理研究中的概念化、测量与评估方法，并指出了未来研究在理论、方法论及实证方面的不足。文献回顾遵循了PRISMA 2020指南进行，搜索范围涵盖2016至2026年期间发表在Scopus数据库中的相关论文，使用了预先定义的ESG与可持续金融关键词。在筛选出的1,591篇文献中，最终确定了28项符合研究要求的研究。研究采用混合方法评估工具（MMAT）对文献的方法论质量进行了评估，并通过基于框架的逻辑分析对相关证据进行了主题性和叙述性的整合。研究发现，ESG被视作一种信息披露机制、风险信号、治理工具、投资标准以及价值创造的动力来源。实证结果表明，ESG有助于提升融资效率、降低资本成本、促进股权融资、增强银行体系的稳定性以及推动绿色创新；然而，这些效应具有显著的情境依赖性，会因ESG的衡量方式、国家背景、行业特征、研究方法及时间范围的不同而有所差异。尽管ESG已成为可持续金融的核心概念，但目前相关证据仍较为分散。本研究通过整合零散的研究成果，提出了关于ESG因果机制、细分维度以及未被充分探索的金融情...。

papers.title: Financial Literacy and Access to Finance among Small Business Owners in Ghana
papers.venue: Asian Journal of Economics Business and Accounting
papers.abstract: This study examines the relationship between financial literacy and access to finance among small business owners in Ghana. Financial literacy was measured through items on budgeting, cash-flow management, interest, financial statements, borrowing costs, insurance and investment risk. A simulated dataset of 242 small businesses was analysed using descriptive statistics, correlation, multiple regression and binary logistic regression. The results indicate moderate financial literacy, with stronger knowledge of budgeting and cash-flow management than insurance and borrowing-cost calculations. Financial literacy significantly predicted access to finance after controlling for business age, size, registration, owner education and financial record-keeping (β = .431, p < .001). Among loan applicants, a one-unit increase in financial literacy more than doubled the odds of approval (OR = 2.203, p < .001). Financial records and collateral also improved approval prospects, while high interest rates and complex documentation remained barriers. The study shows that financial education should be combined with record-keeping support and more accessible lending procedures. Given the cross-sectional design, limited national representativeness and reliance on self-reported financing outcomes, the findings should be interpreted cautiously, and future research should use longitudinal data and lender records while examining regional and sectoral differences.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究探讨了加纳小企业主财务素养与融资渠道之间的关系。财务素养通过预算编制、现金流管理、利息、财务报表、借贷成本、保险以及投资风险等相关指标进行衡量。研究使用了包含242家小企业的模拟数据集，通过描述性统计、相关性分析、多元回归和二元逻辑回归等方法进行了分析。结果表明，这些小企业的财务素养水平处于中等水平，其中在预算编制和现金流管理方面的知识较为扎实，而保险和借贷成本计算方面的知识相对较弱。在控制了企业成立时间、规模、注册情况、业主教育程度以及财务记录保存情况等因素后，财务素养对融资渠道的获取具有显著影响（β = 0.431，p < 0.001）。在贷款申请者中，财务素养每提高一个单位，获得贷款的几率就会增加一倍以上（OR = 2.203，p < 0.001）。良好的财务记录和抵押品也有助于提高贷款获批的可能性，而高利率和复杂的申请流程则成为阻碍融资的障碍。研究表明，应将财务知识教育与财务记录保存支持相结合，并简化贷款流程，以提高小企业的融资便利性。鉴于本研究的横断面设计、全国代表性有限以及数据主要基于自我报告的融资情况，研究结果需谨慎解读；未来的研究应采用纵向数据并结合贷款机构...。研究方法：横截面分析、回归分析。

papers.title: LOB-ID: Evaluating Synthetic Market Data by Inception Distances
papers.abstract: Generative models of limit orderbook (LOB) data have advanced rapidly, but their evaluation often focuses on stylised facts and selected market statistics. These measures provide useful diagnostics but may not capture the joint temporal and cross-level structure of order-book trajectories. We introduce LOB-ID, an embedding-based framework that adapts the Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) and Monge Inception Distance (MIND) to LOB data. To obtain domain-specific embeddings, we train the DeepLOB architecture on four months of Level-2 order-book data for five equities. We show that LOB-ID is stable across time, instruments, and embedding checkpoints, and rises monotonically under controlled distortions. We then construct a moment-matching attack against FID and a deep-book perturbation that evades statistic-based evaluation. MIND remains substantially more sensitive to both distortions. Finally, we score five generative LOB models, spanning stochastic baselines and deep learning approaches, and find that LOB-ID ranks them in line with the joint temporal and cross-level structure each captures by construction.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】生成式订单簿（LOB）数据模型发展迅速，但其评估方法往往侧重于某些特定的市场特征和选定的统计数据。这些评估指标虽然能提供有用的信息，但可能无法全面捕捉订单簿轨迹的时间变化规律及不同层级之间的关联结构。我们提出了LOB-ID这一基于嵌入学习的框架，该框架将Fréchet Inception Distance（FID）和Monge Inception Distance（MIND）算法应用于LOB数据分析中。为了获得与领域特征相匹配的嵌入表示，我们在五种股票的二级订单簿数据上训练了DeepLOB模型（使用了四个月的数据）。实验结果表明，LOB-ID在不同时间点、不同股票以及不同的嵌入参数设置下均表现出稳定性，并且在受到人为干扰时其评估结果仍能保持单调递增的趋势。随后，我们设计了针对FID算法的攻击手段以及一种能够规避基于统计数据的评估方法的模型扰动机制；相比之下，MIND算法对这两种干扰方式的敏感性要显著更高。最后，我们对五种生成式LOB模型进行了评估（这些模型涵盖了随机基线模型和深度学习方法），发现LOB-ID的评估结果能够准确反映各模型在捕捉订单簿时间变化规律及层级结构方面的能力。。研究方法：深度学习、随机过程。

papers.title: Simulating Stress Laws under Extremal Dependence: Characterizing What Generative Models Must Preserve
papers.abstract: We study stress-scenario generation for systems driven by multivariate heavy-tailed risk factors. Within regions where several financial losses are simultaneously extreme, stress analysis concerns both the conditional law of the risk factors and the most plausible configurations producing those losses. We show that both are governed by the same limiting tail law. Preserving its measure recovers rare-event probabilities and scaled conditional stress laws, while misspecifying extremal dependence distorts some regular joint-stress probability. Its density governs reverse-stress optimization, whose maximizers identify the most plausible stress configurations. To exploit this common structure in finite samples, we develop SSGEN (Self-Similar Generative Estimation), which learns extremal dependence from intermediate exceedances and extrapolates to rarer levels using a Pareto radial component. Even when the target event is absent from the sample, we establish convergence rates for the generated conditional law, and data-driven reverse-stress solutions.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了由多变量重尾风险因素驱动的系统的压力情景生成方法。在多个财务损失同时达到极端水平的区域，压力分析既涉及风险因素的条件分布，也涉及导致这些损失的最合理配置。我们发现，这两者都受到相同的极限尾部法则的支配。保持该尾部法则的度量能够恢复罕见事件的概率以及经过缩放的条件压力分布；而错误地指定极端依赖性则会扭曲某些常规的联合压力概率。该尾部法则的密度决定了反向压力优化的过程，其最优解能够识别出最合理的压力配置。为了在有限样本中利用这一共同结构，我们开发了SSGEN（自相似生成估计）方法，该方法通过中间超越值来学习极端依赖性，并利用帕累托径向分量来外推到更罕见的水平。即使目标事件并未出现在样本中，我们也能证明生成的条件分布以及数据驱动的反向压力解的收敛速率是成立的。。研究方法：优化方法。

papers.title: Incidence Bimatrix Games
papers.abstract: We solve a natural bimatrix game related to graphs. We consider a finite directed graph $G=(V,E),$ where the strategy set of Player I is the set of vertices $V$ and that of Player II is the set of edges $E.$ There are two sets of positive weights ${\{α_e\}}_{e\in E}$ and ${\{β_e\}}_{e\in E}.$ If Player I chooses a vertex $v$ and Player II chooses an edge $e,$ then the payoff to both players is zero if $v$ and $e$ are not incident. If $e$ originates from $v,$ then Player I obtains $α_e$ and Player II obtains $-β_e.$ If $e$ terminates at $v,$ then Player I obtains $-α_e$ and Player II obtains $β_e.$ For this game the payoff matrices are weighted incidence matrices of the graph $G.$ We show that when the graph is acyclic, Player I has a unique strategy in any equilibrium. At this strategy, every vertex is chosen with a probability that is proportional to the maximum length over all directed paths originating from that vertex. Defining the path matrix of the graph, it is shown that the set of all equilibrium strategies of Player II is the convex hull of the column vectors of the path matrix. This work extends earlier results of Bapat and Tijs (1997) for zero-sum games.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了一个与图论相关的自然双矩阵博弈问题。考虑一个有限的有向图 $G = (V, E)$，其中玩家 I 的策略集为顶点集 $V$，玩家 II 的策略集为边集 $E$。存在两组正权重值 ${\{α_e\}}_{e \in E}$ 和 ${\{β_e\}}_{e \in E}$。当玩家 I 选择某个顶点 $v$ 且玩家 II 选择某条边 $e$ 时，如果 $v$ 与 $e$ 不相邻，则双方的收益均为零；如果边 $e$ 起始于顶点 $v$，则玩家 I 获得 $α_e$，玩家 II 获得 $-β_e$；如果边 $e$ 终止于顶点 $v$，则玩家 I 获得 $-α_e$，玩家 II 获得 $β_e$。该博弈的收益矩阵实际上就是图 $G$ 的加权关联矩阵。我们证明了当图是无环图时，玩家 I 在任何均衡状态下都存在唯一的最优策略。在该策略下，每个顶点被选择的概率与其出发的所有有向路径中的最长路径长度成正比。通过定义图的路径矩阵，可以证明玩家 II 的所有均衡策略集合构成了该路径矩阵列向量的凸包。这项工作扩展了 Bapat 和 Tijs（1997年）关于零和博弈的研究成果。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Schedule equilibria
papers.abstract: This paper studies imperfect competition in general equilibrium when households and firms choose price-contingent schedules. Market clearing selects the price generated by those schedules, and each agent accounts for how its own behavior changes equilibrium prices. We derive household and firm optimality conditions, establish existence and a trembling-hand refinement, and apply the framework to monopoly, vertical market power, entry, ownership, and technological change. The results show that endogenous price responses can change standard conclusions about markups, deadweight loss, firm creation, and investment.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文研究了在一般均衡条件下，当家庭和企业选择价格依赖型定价策略时所存在的不完全竞争现象。市场出清过程决定了由这些定价策略所产生的价格，同时每个经济主体都会考虑自身的行为如何影响均衡价格。我们推导出了家庭和企业的最优行为条件，证明了该模型的存在性，并对其进行了“颤抖手”（trembling-hand）修正。此外，我们将这一分析框架应用于垄断、垂直市场力量、企业进入、所有权以及技术变革等经济现象。研究结果表明，内生价格反应可能会改变关于利润率、无谓损失、企业创建以及投资等方面的传统结论。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Physical Extinction and Long-Run Pricing under Time-Varying Beliefs
papers.abstract: An investor may be optimistic about aggregate endowment growth at some times and pessimistic at others. The weight placed on her forecast in bond valuation can therefore vary across maturities. We study whether this maturity dependence disappears at the long end of the yield curve. In a two-investor Arrow--Debreu economy, physical extinction follows when \emph{total disagreement} grows without bound. We find that bond valuation depends on net disagreement. If \emph{net disagreement} has no limit, neither the long-forward measure nor the long bond exists. Bond yields can converge along the same belief path. The long yield alone therefore cannot reveal whether valuation weights and bond returns converge across maturities. We also obtain finite-maturity error bounds for bond prices and forward densities.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】投资者在某些时期可能对总体资产增长的预期较为乐观，在其他时期则可能较为悲观。因此，在债券估值过程中，其对未来资产增长的预测所赋予的权重会随着债券到期时间的不同而有所变化。我们研究了这种与债券到期时间相关的权重差异是否会在收益率曲线的远端消失。在一个包含两名投资者的Arrow-Debreu经济模型中，当投资者之间的“总分歧”无限增大时，会导致资产价值的物理性消失（即资产价值归零）。研究发现，债券估值实际上取决于投资者之间的“净分歧”程度。如果“净分歧”没有上限，那么无论是基于远期预期的估值方法，还是长期债券本身都难以成立。在这种情况下，债券收益率可能会沿着相同的预期路径趋于一致。因此，仅通过观察长期收益率是无法判断不同到期时间的债券估值权重和收益率是否能够收敛的。我们还为债券价格和远期概率密度函数得出了有限的误差范围。。

papers.title: Exploring the Path of Digital Finance Empowering Green Transformation of Energy Enterprises Under the Dual-Carbon Goals
papers.venue: Advances in Economics, Management and Political Sciences
papers.abstract: Under the dual carbon targets, China's energy companies are speeding up their green transformation, but they usually encounter some common obstacles including lack of capital, weak technical assistance and an incomplete risk control system. The combination of digital technology and financial services provides new approaches to solve these problems. According to the specific characteristics of the transformation of energy enterprises, this research examines the mechanisms of digital finance from two aspects – financing enhancement and technological enhancement. It is found that methods such as digital green loans, bonds and equity financing can efficiently relieve the financial pressure of enterprises, while technologies like big data, blockchain and artificial intelligence can greatly improve the accuracy of emission reduction and the efficiency of energy operation. Furthermore, the enhancing effects have regional differences and threshold characteristics. Thus, countermeasures are put forward from four fields: improving service provision, deepening technological integration, setting up a risk management system and improving policy regulation, which offer guidance for the actual transformation of energy enterprises and the development of relevant policies.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】在双碳目标的引领下，中国的能源企业正在加快绿色转型进程，但通常会遇到一些共同障碍，包括资金短缺、技术支持不足以及风险控制体系不完善。数字技术与金融服务的结合为解决这些问题提供了新的途径。本研究根据能源企业转型的具体特征，从融资优化和技术升级两个角度探讨了数字金融的支撑机制。研究发现，数字绿色贷款、债券和股权融资等手段能够有效缓解企业的资金压力；而大数据、区块链和人工智能等技术则显著提升了减排的精准度和能源运营的效率。此外，这些技术的提升效果存在地域差异和适用门槛。为此，本文从四个方面提出了应对措施：优化金融服务、深化技术融合、建立风险管理体系以及完善政策监管，为能源企业的实际转型及相关政策的制定提供了指导。。

papers.title: MARKET REACTION TO INDONESIA’S 2025 FINANCE MINISTER CHANGE
papers.venue: The International Conference on Sustainable Economics Management and Accounting Proceeding
papers.abstract: The appointment of a new Minister of Finance on 8 September 2025 is a political–economic event that could influence investor expectations regarding fiscal stability and policy direction. This study aims to examine how the capital market responds to this event by analyzing abnormal returns and trading volume activity. Using an event study method, the sample consists of LQ45 stocks that reflect high market liquidity on the Indonesia Stock Exchange, observed over a window of T−5 to T+5. This study lies in its specific focus on the 2025 ministerial appointment, an event not previously examined, and the combined use of daily analysis and mean-difference testing to evaluate market reactions consistently. The findings show that the market exhibits reactions at several points surrounding the announcement date, as reflected in abnormal returns and trading volume. However, the comparative tests before and after the event indicate no significant differences, suggesting that the reactions are temporary and do not develop into short-term structural changes. These results imply that the market anticipates the appointment effectively, preventing sustained trading pressure. The study provides opportunities for further research with broader variables and sectoral coverage.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】2025年9月8日新财政部长的人选任命是一个具有政治和经济意义的事件，可能会影响投资者对财政稳定性和政策方向的预期。本研究旨在通过分析异常收益和交易量活动来探讨资本市场对此事件的反应。采用事件研究方法，样本选取了印度尼西亚证券交易所流动性较高的LQ45股票，观察时间范围为T−5至T+5期间。该研究的独特之处在于专注于2025年的部长任命这一此前未被研究过的事件，并结合了每日分析和均值差异检验来持续评估市场反应。研究结果表明，在公告发布前后多个时间点，市场都表现出相应的反应，这体现在异常收益和交易量的变化上。然而，事件前后进行的对比测试并未发现显著差异，说明这些市场反应是暂时的，并未引发长期的结构性变化。这些结果表明，市场能够有效预测到这一人事变动，从而避免了持续的交易压力。该研究为未来引入更多变量和涵盖更多行业的研究提供了方向。。研究方法：事件研究。

papers.title: Green finance and tourism-led economic growth
papers.venue: Asian Journal of Economics and Banking
papers.abstract:
This study analyzes the effects of tourism (TOR), green finance (GF), carbon emissions (CO2) and foreign direct investment (FDI) on economic growth (EG) in leading tourist economies.
 
 
 
 This study employs the Residual Augmented Least Squares Engle-Granger (RALS-EG) cointegration approach to test the long-run relationship, followed by the Method of Moments Quantiles Regression (MMQR) to capture heterogeneous effects across different quantiles of EG.
 
 
 
 The finding of the RALS-EG cointegration confirms the existence of a long-run relationship between TOR, GF, CO2, FDI and EG in leading tourist economies. Furthermore, the MMQR findings reveal that TOR and CO2 exert positive and statistically significant effects on EG across all quantiles, while GF positively influences EG across most quantiles (q2 to q9). Moreover, FDI contributes positively to EG, particularly in the upper quantile (q6 to q9), suggesting that its growth-enhancing benefits are more pronounced in economies with greater economic capacity and investment absorption potential
 
 
 
 This study enhances the existing literature in three significant aspects: First, it integrates TOR, GF, and EG within a unified framework; second, it employs RALS-EG and MMQR methods to capture long-run and heterogeneous effects; and third, it provides evidence on the role of GF in supporting sustainable tourism-led growth.
 
 
 
 The findings suggest that leading tourist economies should allocate resources towards the TOR sector, advance sustainable finance and attract FDI to decouple EG from environmental stressors while strengthening environmental sustainability.
papers.summary_zh:
【绿色金融与可持续发展】本研究分析了旅游业（TOR）、绿色金融（GF）、碳排放（CO2）和外国直接投资（FDI）对主要旅游经济体经济增长（EG）的影响。

本研究采用残差增强最小二乘法-恩格尔-格兰杰（RALS-EG）协整方法来检验这些变量之间的长期关系，并进一步运用矩量分位数回归（MMQR）方法来捕捉经济增长在不同分位数上的异质性效应。

RALS-EG协整分析的结果证实了旅游业、绿色金融、碳排放和外国直接投资与主要旅游经济体经济增长之间存在长期关联。MMQR分析进一步表明：旅游业和碳排放对经济增长在所有分位数上均具有显著的正向影响；绿色金融在大多数分位数（q2至q9）上也对经济增长产生积极效应；此外，外国直接投资对经济增长的促进作用尤为明显，尤其是在较高分位数（q6至q9）上，这表明其在经济实力较强、投资吸纳能力较高的经济体中能够更显著地推动经济增长。

本研究在三个重要方面对现有文献进行了补充：首先，它将旅游业、绿色金融和经济增长纳入了一个统一的分析框架；其次，它运用了RALS-EG和MMQR方法来揭示长期效应和异质性特征；最后，它提供了绿色金融在支持可持续旅游发展中的重要作用的证据。

研究结果...。研究方法：协整分析、回归分析。
